function Write-SelfTestProgressPair($Directory, $Row, $RepositoryState, $PredecessorIdentity, [string] $UseId, [int] $Sequence) {
  $BaseTime = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.AddHours(-1).AddMinutes($Sequence * 3)
  $ObservedAt = $BaseTime.ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ', [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
  $CreatedAt = $BaseTime.AddSeconds(1).ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ', [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
  $RecordedAt = $BaseTime.AddSeconds(2).ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ', [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
  $ManifestValue = [ordered]@{
    boundary = [string]$Row.boundary
    createdAt = $CreatedAt
    entries = @([ordered]@{ evidenceId = [string]$Row.requiredEvidenceIds[0]; evidenceKind = 'repository_state'; observedAt = $ObservedAt; ordinal = 1; sourceReceiptSha256 = [string]$RepositoryState.stateSha256 })
    mutationAuthority = $false
    phaseId = [string]$Row.phaseId
    progressOrdinal = [int64]$Row.ordinal
    purpose = 'bind_one_progress_boundary_to_rederived_evidence'
    requiredEvidenceRosterSha256 = '0' * 64
    schemaVersion = 'bob-builtin-analyze/wave0a-terminal-lf-phase-evidence-manifest/v1'
    useId = $UseId
  }
  $ManifestWrite = Write-WaveNewCanonicalLeaf $Directory ([string]$Row.manifestLeaf) $ManifestValue 1048576
  $ProgressValue = [ordered]@{
    boundary = [string]$Row.boundary
    evidenceManifestIdentity = $ManifestWrite.Identity
    mutationAuthority = $false
    ordinal = [int64]$Row.ordinal
    phaseId = [string]$Row.phaseId
    predecessorIdentity = $PredecessorIdentity
    purpose = 'record_one_composed_plan_phase_boundary'
    recordedAt = $RecordedAt
    repositoryState = $RepositoryState
    schemaVersion = 'bob-builtin-analyze/wave0a-terminal-lf-implementation-progress/v1'
    useId = $UseId
  }
  $ProgressWrite = Write-WaveNewCanonicalLeaf $Directory ([string]$Row.progressLeaf) $ProgressValue 1048576
  return [pscustomobject]@{ Manifest = $ManifestWrite; Progress = $ProgressWrite }
}

function New-SelfTestReceipt([string] $SchemaVersion, [string] $ObservedAt) {
  $DirectoryIdentity = ConvertTo-WaveDirectoryIdentity $script:WaveSelfTestRootHandle.Identity $true
  $Inventory = '0' * 64
  $DeletionProof = Get-WaveDomainHash 'bob-builtin-analyze/wave0a-terminal-lf-self-test-deletion/v1' (ConvertTo-WaveCanonicalBytes ([ordered]@{ root = $DirectoryIdentity; before = $Inventory; after = $Inventory }))
  return [ordered]@{
    cleanupResult = 'temporary_root_removed_sentinel_unchanged'
    completedAt = $ObservedAt
    failedCaseCount = [int64]0
    greenObservationSha256 = '0' * 64
    operatorBundleIdentitySha256 = $script:WaveSelfTestBundleContext.BundleSha256
    passedCaseCount = [int64]$script:WaveSelfTestPlanContext.Manifest.selfTestCases.count
    redObservationSha256 = '0' * 64
    schemaVersion = $SchemaVersion
    startedAt = $ObservedAt
    testCaseCount = [int64]$script:WaveSelfTestPlanContext.Manifest.selfTestCases.count
    testCaseRosterSha256 = [string]$script:WaveSelfTestPlanContext.Manifest.selfTestCases.sha256
    workspaceIdentity = [ordered]@{
      deletionProofSha256 = $DeletionProof
      heldAncestorRosterSha256 = '0' * 64
      parentInventoryAfterSha256 = $Inventory
      parentInventoryBeforeSha256 = $Inventory
      protectedSentinelAfterIdentity = Copy-SelfTestCanonicalValue $script:WaveSentinelIdentity
      protectedSentinelBeforeIdentity = Copy-SelfTestCanonicalValue $script:WaveSentinelIdentity
      schemaVersion = 'bob-builtin-analyze/wave0a-terminal-lf-self-test-workspace/v1'
      temporaryParentIdentity = $DirectoryIdentity
      temporaryRootAbsentAfter = $true
      temporaryRootFinalInventorySha256 = '0' * 64
      temporaryRootIdentity = $DirectoryIdentity
      temporaryRootWasAbsentBefore = $true
    }
  }
}

Invoke-SelfTestCase 'bundle.library-reload-preserves-invocation-state' {
  $ReloadText = $script:WaveUtf8.GetString((Get-WaveSectionBytes $script:WaveSelfTestPlanContext 's0001-library'))
  $Marker = 'WAVE0A_LIBRARY_RELOAD_PRESERVED_INVOCATION_STATE'
  $SeedLine = '$Probe=@([object]::new(),[object]::new(),[object]::new(),[object]::new(),[IO.MemoryStream]::new());$script:WaveBoundPlan=$Probe[0];$script:WaveBoundBundle=$Probe[1];$script:WaveBoundAction=$Probe[2];$script:WaveBoundActionTemplate=$Probe[3];$script:WaveParentInvocationLease=$Probe[4]'
  $CheckLine = 'try{if(-not([object]::ReferenceEquals($script:WaveBoundPlan,$Probe[0])-and[object]::ReferenceEquals($script:WaveBoundBundle,$Probe[1])-and[object]::ReferenceEquals($script:WaveBoundAction,$Probe[2])-and[object]::ReferenceEquals($script:WaveBoundActionTemplate,$Probe[3])-and[object]::ReferenceEquals($script:WaveParentInvocationLease,$Probe[4]))){throw "reload replaced bound state"};[Console]::Out.Write("' + $Marker + '")}finally{$Probe[4].Dispose()}'
  $ProbeBytes = $script:WaveUtf8.GetBytes($ReloadText + $SeedLine + "`n" + $ReloadText + $CheckLine + "`n")
  $Result = Invoke-WavePinnedProcess $script:WavePwshIdentity @('-NoLogo','-NoProfile','-NonInteractive','-Command','-') $ProbeBytes 4096 4096 300000
  Assert-Wave ($Result.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $Result.Stderr.Length -eq 0 -and $script:WaveUtf8.GetString($Result.Stdout) -ceq $Marker) 'isolated library reload did not preserve invocation state'
}

Invoke-SelfTestCase 'caps.commandline-32765-32766-32767' {
  $Executable = [string]$script:WaveNodeIdentity.canonicalPath
  $QuotedExecutableLength = if ($Executable.IndexOfAny([char[]]@(' ',"`t","`n",[char]0x0b,'"')) -ge 0) { $Executable.Length + 2 } else { $Executable.Length }
  $Code = 'process.exit(0)'
  $FixedLength = $QuotedExecutableLength + 1 + 2 + 1 + $Code.Length + 1
  foreach ($TargetLength in @(32765,32766)) {
    $Filler = 'a' * ($TargetLength - $FixedLength)
    $Result = Invoke-WavePinnedProcess $script:WaveNodeIdentity @('-e',$Code,$Filler) ([byte[]]::new(0)) 0 0 30000
    Assert-Wave ($Result.ExitCode -eq 0) "command-line boundary $TargetLength failed"
  }
  $RejectedFiller = 'a' * (32767 - $FixedLength)
  Assert-SelfTestThrows { Invoke-WavePinnedProcess $script:WaveNodeIdentity @('-e',$Code,$RejectedFiller) ([byte[]]::new(0)) 0 0 30000 }
}

$NativeDir = [Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::CreateDirectoryNew($script:WaveSelfTestRootHandle, 'native-fixtures')
try {

    $Bytes = $script:WaveUtf8.GetBytes('value')
    $File = [Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::CreateFileNew($NativeDir,'value.bin')
    try { $Written = [Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::WriteFileAndVerify($NativeDir,$File,$Bytes,32) } finally { $File.Dispose() }
    $Reopened = [Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::OpenFile($NativeDir,'value.bin',$false)
    try {
      $Read = [Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::ReadFileBytes($Reopened,32)
      $Snapshot = [Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::SnapshotFile($Reopened,32)
      Assert-Wave (Test-WaveByteEqual $Bytes $Read) 'native reopen bytes changed'
      Assert-Wave ($Written.SnapshotEquals($Snapshot) -and $Snapshot.Sha256 -ceq (Get-WaveSha256 $Bytes)) 'native reopen identity changed'
    } finally { $Reopened.Dispose() }
  }
  Invoke-SelfTestCase 'native.exclusive-mutation-open' { $First=[Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::OpenFile($NativeDir,'value.bin',$true); try { Assert-SelfTestThrows { $Second=[Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::OpenFile($NativeDir,'value.bin',$true); $Second.Dispose() } } finally { $First.Dispose() } }

Invoke-SelfTestCase 'process.executable-runtime-identity-ctime-only' {
  $Opened = Open-WaveFile ([string]$script:WaveNodeIdentity.canonicalPath) $false $false
  try {
    $Actual = [Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::SnapshotFile($Opened.File, [int64]$script:WaveNodeIdentity.size)
    $Expected = Copy-SelfTestCanonicalValue (ConvertTo-WaveExternalIdentity $Actual)
    $Expected.ctimeNs = (([uint64]$Expected.ctimeNs) + [uint64]1).ToString([Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
    Assert-WaveExecutableIdentity $Expected $Actual $true
    foreach ($Field in @('canonicalPath','dev','ino','size','mtimeNs','linkCount','reparseTag','sha256')) {
      $Drift = Copy-SelfTestCanonicalValue $Expected
      if ($Field -ceq 'canonicalPath') { $Drift[$Field] = [string]$Drift[$Field] + '.drift' }
      elseif ($Field -ceq 'sha256') { $Drift[$Field] = if ([string]$Drift[$Field] -ceq ('f' * 64)) { 'e' * 64 } else { 'f' * 64 } }
      else { $Drift[$Field] = (([uint64]$Drift[$Field]) + [uint64]1).ToString([Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture) }
      Assert-SelfTestThrows { Assert-WaveExecutableIdentity $Drift $Actual $true }
    }
  } finally { Close-WaveHandles $Opened.Handles }
}

Invoke-SelfTestCase 'process.descendant-kill-on-overflow' {
  $EscapeLeaf = 'descendant-escape.bin'
  $EscapePath = ([string]$script:WaveSelfTestRootHandle.Identity.CanonicalPath).TrimEnd([char[]]@('\','/')) + '\' + $EscapeLeaf
  $ChildCode = 'setTimeout(()=>require("node:fs").writeFileSync(process.argv[1],"escaped"),1500)'
  $ParentCode = 'const{spawn}=require("node:child_process");spawn(process.execPath,["-e",process.argv[1],process.argv[2]],{stdio:"ignore"});process.stdout.write("xx");setInterval(()=>{},1000)'
  $Escaped = $false
  try {
    Assert-SelfTestThrows { Invoke-WavePinnedProcess $script:WaveNodeIdentity @('-e',$ParentCode,$ChildCode,$EscapePath) ([byte[]]::new(0)) 1 1024 30000 }
    [Threading.Thread]::Sleep(2500)
    $Escaped = (Get-WaveEvidenceNames $script:WaveSelfTestRootHandle) -ccontains $EscapeLeaf
  } finally {
    if ((Get-WaveEvidenceNames $script:WaveSelfTestRootHandle) -ccontains $EscapeLeaf) { Remove-WaveExactLeaf $script:WaveSelfTestRootHandle $EscapeLeaf 32 }
  }
  Assert-Wave (-not $Escaped) 'descendant escaped the failed process job'
}

Invoke-SelfTestCase 'receipt.node-nondeterministic-output-stable' {
  $ObservedAt = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.AddMinutes(-1).ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ', [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
  $Existing = [ordered]@{
    commandId = 'selftest.node'
    commandInputPolicySha256 = $script:WaveCommandInputPolicySha256
    completedAt = $ObservedAt
    environmentNameValueManifestSha256 = $script:WaveEnvironmentSha256
    runs = @([ordered]@{
      argv = @('--test','selftest.mjs')
      completedExitCode = [int64]0
      executableIdentity = Copy-SelfTestCanonicalValue $script:WaveNodeIdentity
      stderrByteLength = [int64]0
      stderrSha256 = '0' * 64
      stdoutByteLength = [int64]101
      stdoutSha256 = '1' * 64
      workingDirectory = Copy-SelfTestCanonicalValue $script:WaveCwdIdentity
    })
    schemaVersion = 'bob-builtin-analyze/wave0a-terminal-lf-command-receipt/v1'
    startedAt = $ObservedAt
  }
  $Fresh = Copy-SelfTestCanonicalValue $Existing
  $Fresh.startedAt = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(-2).ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ', [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
  $Fresh.completedAt = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(-1).ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ', [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
  $Fresh.runs[0].stdoutByteLength = [int64]203
  $Fresh.runs[0].stdoutSha256 = '2' * 64
  $Fresh.runs[0].stderrByteLength = [int64]17
  $Fresh.runs[0].stderrSha256 = '3' * 64
  $Specs = @([ordered]@{ argv=@('--test','selftest.mjs'); expectedExit=[int64]0 })
  $NotBefore = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.AddMinutes(-2)
  [void](Assert-WaveNodeCommandReceipt ([pscustomobject]@{ Value=$Existing }) 'selftest.node' $Specs $NotBefore)
  [void](Assert-WaveNodeCommandReceipt ([pscustomobject]@{ Value=$Fresh }) 'selftest.node' $Specs $NotBefore)
  Assert-WaveCommandReceiptStableEquivalence $Existing $Fresh 'self-test nondeterministic Node receipt'
}

Invoke-SelfTestCase 'canonical.self-bound-byte-identical-substitution-reject' {
  Invoke-SelfTestHeldDirectory 'self-bound-substitution-fixtures' @('padding.bin','record.json') {
    param($Directory)
    $Original = Write-WaveNewCanonicalLeaf $Directory 'record.json' ([ordered]@{ schemaVersion='selftest/self-bound/v1'; value='fixed' }) 4096
    Remove-WaveExactLeaf $Directory 'record.json' 4096
    $Padding = [Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::CreateFileNew($Directory,'padding.bin')
    try { [void]([Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::WriteFileAndVerify($Directory,$Padding,$script:WaveUtf8.GetBytes('reserve-next-file-id'),4096)) } finally { $Padding.Dispose() }
    $Replacement = [Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::CreateFileNew($Directory,'record.json')
    try {
      $ReplacementIdentity = [Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::WriteFileAndVerify($Directory,$Replacement,[byte[]]$Original.Bytes,4096)
      Assert-Wave (([uint64]$ReplacementIdentity.FileId).ToString() -cne [string]$Original.Identity.ino) 'replacement unexpectedly reused the original file ID'
    } finally { $Replacement.Dispose() }
    Assert-SelfTestThrowsExact { Read-WaveCanonicalLeaf $Directory 'record.json' 4096 } 'Wave0A terminal-LF operator: canonical leaf record.json self object key mismatch'
  }
}

Invoke-SelfTestCase 'receipt.auxiliary-prefix-adoption' {
  $Row = [ordered]@{
    boundary = 'complete'
    diffAfterReceiptLeaf = '06-diff-after.json'
    diffBeforeReceiptLeaf = '02-diff-before.json'
    greenAfterReceiptLeaf = '05-green-after.json'
    greenBeforeReceiptLeaf = '01-green-before.json'
    manifestLeaf = '07-manifest.json'
    progressLeaf = '08-progress.json'
    reviewChallengeLeaf = '03-challenge.json'
    reviewReceiptLeaves = @('04-review.json')
    rowId = 'selftest-auxiliary-prefix'
  }
  $Sequence = @($Row.greenBeforeReceiptLeaf,$Row.diffBeforeReceiptLeaf,$Row.reviewChallengeLeaf) + @($Row.reviewReceiptLeaves) + @($Row.greenAfterReceiptLeaf,$Row.diffAfterReceiptLeaf,$Row.manifestLeaf,$Row.progressLeaf)
  for ($PrefixLength = 0; $PrefixLength -le $Sequence.Count; $PrefixLength++) {
    Invoke-SelfTestHeldDirectory "auxiliary-prefix-$PrefixLength" $Sequence {
      param($Directory)
      for ($Index = 0; $Index -lt $PrefixLength; $Index++) { [void](Write-WaveNewCanonicalLeaf $Directory ([string]$Sequence[$Index]) ([ordered]@{ ordinal=[int64]$Index; schemaVersion='selftest/auxiliary-prefix/v1' }) 4096) }
      $Chain = [pscustomobject]@{ Evidence = $Directory }
      Assert-WaveEvidenceInventory $Chain ([ordered]@{ progressRows=@($Row) }) 0 'selftest-auxiliary-prefix' $false
      $Leases = New-WaveLeaseSet
      try {
        for ($Index = 0; $Index -lt $PrefixLength; $Index++) {
          $Record = Read-WaveCanonicalLeaf $Directory ([string]$Sequence[$Index]) 4096 $Leases $true
          Assert-Wave ([string]$Record.Value.schemaVersion -ceq 'selftest/auxiliary-prefix/v1' -and [int64]$Record.Value.ordinal -eq $Index) 'auxiliary prefix payload drift'
          Confirm-WaveCanonicalLeafAdoption $Record "self-test auxiliary prefix[$Index]"
        }
        Assert-WaveLeaseSetStable $Leases
      } finally { Close-WaveLeaseSet $Leases }
    }
  }
}

Invoke-SelfTestCase 'repository.task0-draft-lease-mixed-view-reject' {
  Invoke-SelfTestHeldDirectory 'task0-draft-lease-fixtures' @('draft.bin') {
    param($Directory)
    $Bytes = $script:WaveUtf8.GetBytes('fixed-task0-draft')
    $Creator = [Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::CreateFileNew($Directory,'draft.bin')
    try { [void]([Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::WriteFileAndVerify($Directory,$Creator,$Bytes,1024)) } finally { $Creator.Dispose() }
    $Path = ([string]$Directory.Identity.CanonicalPath).TrimEnd([char[]]@('\','/')) + '/draft.bin'
    $Leases = New-WaveLeaseSet
    try {
      $LeasedFile = [Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::OpenFile($Directory,'draft.bin',$false)
      $Transferred = $false
      try {
        $Snapshot = [Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::SnapshotFile($LeasedFile,1024)
        Assert-WaveHeldObjectAcceptable $LeasedFile 'self-test Task 0 draft after snapshot'
        $Identity = ConvertTo-WaveExternalIdentity $Snapshot
        Assert-Wave ([string]$Identity.canonicalPath -ceq $Path -and [string]$Identity.sha256 -ceq (Get-WaveSha256 $Bytes)) 'self-test Task 0 draft identity mismatch'
        Add-WaveFixedLeafLease $Leases $LeasedFile $Snapshot 1024 'self-test Task 0 draft'
        $Transferred = $true
      } finally { if (-not $Transferred) { $LeasedFile.Dispose() } }
      $ObservationBefore = Get-WaveInventoryHash $Directory
      Assert-SelfTestThrows { $Mutable = [Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::OpenFile($Directory,'draft.bin',$true); $Mutable.Dispose() }
      Assert-WaveLeaseSetStable $Leases
      $ObservationAfter = Get-WaveInventoryHash $Directory
      Assert-Wave ($ObservationBefore -ceq $ObservationAfter -and [string]$Identity.sha256 -ceq (Get-WaveSha256 $Bytes)) 'Task 0 draft lease did not bind one observation'
    } finally { Close-WaveLeaseSet $Leases }
  }
}

Invoke-SelfTestCase 'repository.directory-event-transient-reject' {
  Invoke-SelfTestHeldDirectory 'directory-event-transient-fixtures' @() {
    param($Directory)
    $BeforeInventory = Get-WaveInventoryHash $Directory 16
    $Leases = New-WaveLeaseSet
    try {
      [void](Add-WaveTrackedDirectoryInventoryLease $Leases $Directory '' 'self-test transient directory event')
      Assert-WaveLeaseSetStable $Leases
      Assert-WaveLeaseSetStable $Leases
      $Created = [Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::CreateFileNew($Directory,'transient.bin')
      try {
        $Identity = [Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::WriteFileAndVerify($Directory,$Created,$script:WaveUtf8.GetBytes('transient'),4096)
        [Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::DeleteFileSameHandle($Directory,$Created,$Identity,16,4096)
      } finally { $Created.Dispose() }
      $AfterInventory = Get-WaveInventoryHash $Directory 16
      Assert-Wave ($BeforeInventory -ceq $AfterInventory) 'transient directory fixture did not restore its inventory'
      $MutationError = $null
      try { Assert-WaveLeaseSetStable $Leases } catch { $MutationError = $_.Exception }
      Assert-Wave ($null -ne $MutationError -and $MutationError.ToString().Contains('DirectoryMutationLease.Checkpoint: directory mutation observed', [StringComparison]::Ordinal)) 'transient event was not rejected by the directory mutation lease'
    } finally { Close-WaveLeaseSet $Leases }
  }
}

Invoke-SelfTestCase 'repository.directory-guard-extra-create-reject' {
  Invoke-SelfTestHeldDirectory 'directory-guard-extra-create-fixtures' @('authorized.bin','injected.bin') {
    param($Directory)
    $Leases = New-WaveLeaseSet
    $Authorized = $null
    $Injected = $null
    try {
      [void](Add-WaveDirectoryInventoryGuard $Leases $Directory 'self-test exact-create negative' 16)
      $Descriptors = @(Suspend-WaveDirectoryInventoryGuards $Leases $Directory)
      Assert-Wave ($Descriptors.Count -eq 1) 'exact-create negative suspension count mismatch'
      $Authorized = [Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::CreateFileNew($Directory,'authorized.bin')
      $AuthorizedIdentity = [Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::WriteFileAndVerify($Directory,$Authorized,$script:WaveUtf8.GetBytes('authorized'),4096)
      $Injected = [Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::CreateFileNew($Directory,'injected.bin')
      [void]([Wave0A.TerminalLf.Native.NativeFs]::WriteFileAndVerify($Directory,$Injected,$script:WaveUtf8.GetBytes('injected'),4096))
      Assert-SelfTestThrowsExact { Resume-WaveDirectoryInventoryGuards $Leases $Directory $Descriptors 'authorized.bin' $AuthorizedIdentity } 'Wave0A terminal-LF operator: self-test exact-create negative exact-create inventory count mismatch'
      Assert-Wave (@($Leases.Records | Where-Object { [string]$_.Kind -ceq 'directory_inventory' }).Count -eq 0) 'failed exact-create rotation updated the directory guard baseline'
    } finally {
      if ($null -ne $Injected) { $Injected.Dispose() }
      if ($null -ne $Authorized) { $Authorized.Dispose() }
      Close-WaveLeaseSet $Leases
    }
  }
}

  } finally { Close-WaveHandles $Authority.Handles }
}

Invoke-SelfTestCase 'progress.manifest-only-adoption' {
  Invoke-SelfTestHeldDirectory 'manifest-only-adoption-fixtures' @('progress-1-manifest.json','progress-1-record.json') {
    param($Directory)
    $State = Get-WaveRepositoryState
    $Use = New-SelfTestProgressUse $State
    $Row = New-SelfTestProgressRow 1 'start'
    $ObservedAt = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.AddMinutes(-2).ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ', [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
    $CreatedAt = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.AddMinutes(-1).ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ', [Globalization.CultureInfo]::InvariantCulture)
    $Entries = @([ordered]@{ evidenceId=[string]$Row.requiredEvidenceIds[0]; evidenceKind='repository_state'; observedAt=$ObservedAt; ordinal=[int64]1; sourceReceiptSha256=[string]$State.stateSha256 })
    $ManifestValue = New-WaveEvidenceManifest $Use $Row $Entries $CreatedAt
    $ExistingManifest = Write-WaveNewCanonicalLeaf $Directory ([string]$Row.manifestLeaf) $ManifestValue 1048576
    $Leases = New-WaveLeaseSet
    try {
      $Chain = [pscustomobject]@{ Evidence=$Directory; Leases=$Leases; Mutable=$true }
      $Published = Write-WaveProgressBoundary $Chain $Use $Row $Use.Receipt.Identity $State $Entries $Use.ReceiptAt
      Assert-Wave ((ConvertTo-WaveJcsValue $Published.Manifest.Identity) -ceq (ConvertTo-WaveJcsValue $ExistingManifest.Identity)) 'manifest-only crash arm replaced the manifest'
      Assert-Wave ((Get-WaveEvidenceNames $Directory).Count -eq 2 -and [bool]$Published.Manifest.Confirmed) 'manifest-only crash arm did not adopt then create one progress leaf'
      Assert-WaveLeaseSetStable $Leases
    } finally { Close-WaveLeaseSet $Leases }
  }
}
